&AuditTableName = !'Prensa'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&LoadSuccess = True
	If (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Display)
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert AND WWPBaseObjects.SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'prensa_Insert'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Update AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'prensa_Update'))
		OR (&TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete AND SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'prensa_Delete'))
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Insert
			&Prensa.Load(&PrensaId)
			&LoadSuccess = &Prensa.Success()
			If not &LoadSuccess
				&Messages = &Prensa.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Display OR &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&EnumPrensa.Enabled = False
				Prensa_PrensaNombre.Enabled = False
				Prensa_PrensaImagen.Enabled = False
				Prensa_PrensaMarca.Enabled = False
				Prensa_PrensaModelo.Enabled = False
			EndIf
		EndIf
	Else
		&LoadSuccess = False
	EndIf
	If &LoadSuccess
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
			msg('GXM_confdelete')
		EndIf
	EndIf
	Do 'AttributesSecurityCode'
	Prensa_PrensaId.Visible = False
	wcAuditoria.Object = AuditHistoryById.Create(&AuditTableName, &PrensaId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case Not &TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert
			&EnumPrensa = EnumPrensa.Convert(&Prensa.PrensaId)
	EndCase

Do Case
		Case &TrnMode = TrnMode.Insert
			&Prensa.PrensaId = EnumPrensa.Convert(&EnumPrensa)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Display
		If &TrnMode <> TrnMode.Delete
			Do 'CheckRequiredFields'
		EndIf
		If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete OR &CheckRequiredFieldsResult
			If &TrnMode = TrnMode.Delete
				&Prensa.Delete()
			Else
				&Prensa.Save()
			EndIf
			If &Prensa.Success()
				Do 'After_Trn'
			Else
				&Messages = &Prensa.GetMessages()
				Do 'Show Messages'
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
